slice: Verify the exact released construction and router-handler return seam for an application-owned durable task handle without invoking stock TaskManager::spawn.

evidence.finding: Task::new(task_id,status,created_at,last_updated_at) and CreateTaskResult::new(Task) are public constructors; CreateTaskResult embeds the server-generated stable task id and seed task state.
CallToolResponse has public Task(CreateTaskResult), From<CreateTaskResult> for CallToolResponse, and conversion of CallToolResponse::Task into ServerResult::CreateTaskResult.

Registered tool adapters accept return R: IntoCallToolResult. IntoCallToolResult is implemented for CallToolResponse, but not directly for CreateTaskResult in this file; therefore the handler can return CallToolResponse::Task(CreateTaskResult::new(task)) (or an equivalent CallToolResponse conversion) without calling TaskManager::spawn.

result: SOURCE_QUALIFIED_POSITIVE_WITH_TYPE_NUANCE: rmcp-v3.1.4 exposes a released public path for a router-first registered tool handler to return an application-owned Task as a protocol CreateTaskResult without invoking stock TaskManager::spawn. Return the handle as CallToolResponse (CreateTaskResult alone is not shown implementing IntoCallToolResult).
scope_limits: Source-qualified only; no local cargo/rustc compile or runtime execution was performed in this slice.
This closes only handle construction/return through the released tool-response surface.
It does not prove application-store tasks/get wiring, restart redrive, cancellation/update semantics, task capability pre-materialization, or external-effect exactly-once safety.
No inference is made beyond rmcp-v3.1.4 exact release source.
residual_dependency_detail: Full Phase-1 parity remains unresolved because a durable application-owned executor/store, restart redrive, and external-effect idempotency/fencing are still required proof obligations; this slice does not count those as solved.
conflict_check: One bounded rmcp continuation leaf only; no OpenHands or second optional leaf started; no scheduler or non-role-local mutation.
exact_continuation: Next invocation only: source-pin the exact rmcp-v3.1.4 ServerHandler get_task/update_task/cancel_task signatures and GetTaskResult/DetailedTask constructors needed to back those methods from an application-owned durable store, then write a compile-oriented minimal skeleton that returns CallToolResponse::Task from the router-first tool handler and serves tasks/get without stock TaskManager or TaskContext. Mark it NOT COMPILED unless an in-scope compiler surface actually exists. Stop after that one slice; do not start OpenHands or a second optional leaf.
